name: 19807 · Wilmington, DE
findings: ZIP 19807 (Wilmington) has 136 nonprofit organizations. 40 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19807 (Wilmington) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19807 (Wilmington) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 33 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.
